instruction: Glitch is crashing. Have him jab the stimpak into his own arm.

target.reason: The end state Glitch wants is to have used the stimpak on himself, but the page only moves items between people (offer/accept) or between places; no verb lets a person use or apply an item, and merely holding it is already the state the instruction starts from.
